name: OneShot Provision Monitor
description: Polls oneshotmn/.github Actions runs every minute and checks oneshot.help reachability, so provisioning activity and logs are visible in n8n.

parameters.content:
## OneShot Provision Monitor

Polls the org .github repo every minute for Actions runs, and checks whether oneshot.help is serving.

Open any execution to read the full run log. The `runs` array carries one row per workflow run with a direct `logs_url` into GitHub.

The site check runs from this Mac, so it is a reachability signal only, not proof a visitor can load the site.
